rules: this node owns its lib, content, data, queue, admission, refusal, and provider receipts
customers retain repository and filesystem authority; the Git Services Section retains Git command validation and supplies only its attenuated request
this provider has no Git contract and recognizes only its registered Git Services Section client
device-wide-enforced service is refused until the host grants an io-controller and execution-boundary witness
a provider receipt records an observed operation, never an entitlement to bypass the queue
